Mari: Quick sync — we need to decide GPU SKU priority for the upcoming low-latency eval (seq=1024, batch=1). A100/H100/L40S tradeoffs? Thinking latency first, cost second. Any objections if we default to H100 for canary?

Kevin: Not an objection, but H100 gives best latency for 2048 context. For 1024 it's close to L40S in some kernels. Need exact model & quantization.

TJ: model is redwood-1-13b-q4 (int4). Can we get 95th p99 numbers for p99 token latency and p50? Also want memory footprint.

Simon: FYI current canary runs on H100 with 2xKV cache pinned. Observed p99 spikes around 180ms for batch=1 seq=1024.

Bench-bot: Automated result: A100 (p50=70ms p99=220ms mem=24GB), H100 (p50=60ms p99=170ms mem=22GB), L40S (p50=65ms p99=190ms mem=20GB) — run id 2026-03-15T09:12

Rachel: Cost check — per-hour and per-token: A100 > H100 > L40S in our pricing. We should also consider Reserved capacity pricing and commit discounts.

Kevin: Correct. L40S is cheapest per-hour but shows more tail variance. If strict p99 SLO, H100 seems safer.

Maya: I can run a short sweep tonight with these configs. Plan: three runs per SKU, seed=42, seq=1024, batch=1, 50 samples. I'll post raw CSV.

Mari: Thanks @Maya — can you include kernels/driver versions? Last time driver 535.x improved H100 tail, want same baseline.

Maya: Will do. Also pinging @TJ for review of the run script. Script I plan to use:
```
python tools/bench/run.py --model redwood-1-13b-q4 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --samples 50 --gpu ${SKU} --seed 42
```
I'll create a short PR with the exact YAML.

TJ: LGTM, please include perf tracing flags (--trace-kv --cpu-profiling) so we can see microbursts.

Simon: If Maya needs capacity, I can temporarily free a slot on the H100 pool tonight.

Mari: Great. If results show H100 p99 < 180ms and cost delta < 8%, we default H100 for canary. Otherwise fallback to L40S for cost. :white_check_mark:

Bench-bot: Note: please file a follow-up issue if we see regressions — template: /issues/new?template=perf_regression
